doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Hall leaves the band; the Cincinnati breakup and social security card
summary: Hall left for a year, rejoined, and stayed in Cincinnati when the band broke up; his card shows 1938.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band
